([[Suwanee, Georgia]]) | college = [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]] (2018–2020) | highlights = * Second-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] ([[2019–20 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|2020]]) }} '''Devin Vassell''' (born August 23, 2000) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State Seminoles]]. ==Early life and high school career== Vassell grew up in [[Suwanee, Georgia]] and attended [[Peachtree Ridge High School]]. As a senior, Vassell averaged 21.6 points and 8.9 rebounds per game and was named the regional Player of the Year by the ''[[Gwinnett Daily Post]]''.{{cite web|url=https://www.gwinnettdailypost.com/sports/peachtree-ridge-grad-devin-vassell-turns-into-super-sub-as/article_de07b60f-ed3e-5fa1-91b0-8ff6735493d6.html|title=Peachtree Ridge grad Devin Vassell turns into super sub as Florida State freshman|first=Paul|last=Thomas|work=[[Gwinnett Daily Post]]|date=March 4, 2019|access-date=January 16, 2020}} Vassell committed to play college basketball at Florida State over offers from [[Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball|Texas Tech]], [[North Florida Ospreys men's basketball|North Florida]], and [[Stetson Hatters men's basketball|Stetson]].{{cite web|url=https://www.tomahawknation.com/2017/5/3/15527554/devin-vassell-commits-fsu-basketball|title=Devin Vassell commits to FSU basketball|first=David|last=Visser|website=TomahawkNation.com|publisher=SB Nation|date=May 3, 2017|access-date=January 17, 2020}} ==College career== As a true freshman, Vassell averaged 4.5 points and 1.5 rebounds per game and led all ACC freshman with a .419 three-point shooting percentage.{{cite web|url=https://accsports.com/acc-analytics/stock-rising-devin-vassell-fsu-stats/|title=STOCK RISING: CAN FSU’S DEVIN VASSELL EMERGE AS ONE OF THE TOP 3-AND-D PROSPECTS IN THE COUNTRY?|first=Brian|last=Geislinger|website=ACCSports.com|date=May 14, 2019|access-date=January 16, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.tallahassee.com/story/sports/college/fsu/mensbasketball/2019/10/21/fsu-basketball-guard-devin-vassell-becoming-more-all-around-player/4044390002/|title=Florida State basketball guard Devin Vassell becoming a more all-around player|first=Wayne|last=McGahee III|work=[[Tallahassee Democrat]]|date=October 21, 2019|access-date=January 16, 2020}} He scored a season-high 16 points on December 17, 2018 in a win over [[2018–19 Southeast Missouri State Redhawks men's basketball team|Southeast Missouri State]].{{cite web|url=https://www.tallahassee.com/story/sports/college/fsu/mensbasketball/2018/12/17/trent-forrest-leads-florida-state-past-southeast-missouri/2335915002/|title=Trent Forrest leads Florida State past Southeast Missouri|work=[[Tallahassee Democrat]]|date=December 17, 2018|access-date=March 23, 2020}} Vassell made a three-pointer with 4.5 seconds left in regulation to force overtime in the Seminoles' 65–63 win over [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2019 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/florida-state/Article/Big-shots-from-Devin-Vassell-Terance-Mann-help-FSU-defeat-VT-at-ACC-Tournament-130079430/|title=Big shots from Vassell, Mann help FSU defeat VT at ACC Tourney|first=Chris|last=Nee|website=247Sports.com|date=March 14, 2019|access-date=January 16, 2020}} [[File:Devin Vassell.jpg|thumb|left|Vassell in 2020]] He was named a starter for the Seminoles' going into his sophomore season. Vassell was named the Most Outstanding Player of the 2019 [[Emerald Coast Classic]] after scoring 16 points against [[Chicago State Cougars men's basketball|Chicago State]], 13 against 17th-ranked [[Tennessee Volunteers men's basketball|Tennessee]] and 13 points against [[Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball|Purdue]] in the final.{{cite web|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/basketball-ncaa-pur-fls/florida-state-edges-purdue-in-ot-to-win-emerald-coast-title-idUSMTZXEFC1TBTE39|title=Florida State edges Purdue in OT to win Emerald Coast title|website=Reuters.com|date=November 30, 2019|access-date=January 16, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.jacksonville.com/sports/20191125/devin-vassell-patrick-williams-lead-florida-state-to-romp-over-chicago-state|title=Devin Vassell, Patrick Williams lead Florida State to romp over Chicago State|work=Florida Times-Union|date=November 25, 2019}}{{cite web|url=https://www.jacksonville.com/sports/20191129/devin-vassell-leads-florida-state-over-no-17-tennessee|title=Devin Vassell leads Florida State over No. 17 Tennessee|work=Florida Times-Union|date=November 29, 2019}} Midway through the season Vassell's play lead him to be considered as a potential first round pick in the 2020 NBA draft.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28477446/college-basketball-picks-duke-louisville-take-charge-acc|title=College basketball picks -- Can Duke or Louisville take charge in the ACC?|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=January 17, 2020|access-date=January 17, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2871395-2020-nba-draft-big-board-who-is-lamelo-balls-biggest-threat-for-no-1#slide4|title=2020 NBA Draft Big Board: Who Is LaMelo Ball's Biggest Threat for No. 1?|first=Jonathan|last=Wasserman|website=[[Bleacher Report]]|date=January 16, 2020|access-date=January 17, 2020}} He scored a career-high 18 points against [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]] in a 54–50 victory and set a new career high the next game with 23 points and 11 rebounds against Miami and was named the ACC co-Player of the Week.{{cite web|url=https://wnyt.com/sports/vassell-polite-help-no-9-florida-state-edge-virginia-54-50/5611083/|title=Vassell, Polite help No. 9 Florida State edge Virginia 54-50|first=Bob|last=Ferrante|website=WNYT.com|publisher=Associated Press|date=January 15, 2020|access-date=January 17, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/florida-state/Article/Devin-Vassell-named-ACC-co-player-of-the-week-marking-first-honor-for-a-Florida-State-Seminoles-this-season-142493946/|title=Vassell earns first ACC honor for a ‘Nole this basketball season|first=Chris|last=Nee|website=247Sports.com|date=January 20, 2020|access-date=January 22, 2020}} Vassell surpassed his previous career high with 27 points while going 7–for–7 on three point shots against Virginia Tech on February 1, 2020.{{cite web|url=https://www.tampabay.com/sports/seminoles/2020/02/02/no-5-fsu-seminoles-ride-record-tying-3-point-shooting-of-devin-vassell/|title=No. 5 FSU Seminoles ride record-tying 3-point shooting of Devin Vassell|work=[[Tampa Bay Times]]|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|date=February 2, 2020|access-date=February 3, 2020}} Vassell missed a game against [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]] for undisclosed reasons on February 15.{{cite news |title=No. 8 Florida State survives Syracuse without Devin Vassell |url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2020/02/15/no-8-florida-state-survives-syracuse-without-devin-vassell/ |accessdate=February 15, 2020 |work=[[NBC Sports]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=February 15, 2020}} At the conclusion of the regular season, Vassell was selected to the Second Team All-ACC.{{cite web|url=https://theacc.com/news/2020/3/8/athlete-awards-2020-acc-mens-basketball-award-winners-announced.aspx|title=2020 ACC Men’s Basketball Award Winners Announced|website=theacc.com|publisher=Atlantic Coast Conference|date=March 9, 2020|accessdate=March 9, 2020}} He led the team in scoring with 12.7 points per game and in rebounding with 5.1 per game and was second on the team in blocks (29), assists (49) and steals (42).{{cite web |title=Watch: Devin Vassell 2019-20 Season Highlights|url=https://www.yardbarker.com/college_basketball/articles/watch_devin_vassell_2019_20seasonhighlights_florida_state_guard/s1_15635_31594631 |website=Yardbarker |accessdate=March 19, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/florida-state/Article/Florida-State-sophomore-guard-Devin-Vassell-declares-NBA-Draft-145310502/|title=FSU’s Devin Vassell declares for the 2020 NBA Draft|first=Chris|last=Nee|website=247Sports.com|date=March 23, 2020|access-date=March 23, 2020}} Following the end of the season, Vassell announced that he would enter the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite web|url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2020/03/23/florida-states-devin-vassell-declares-for-the-draft/|title=Florida State’s Devin Vassell declares for the
